import process from 'node:process'
import { defineConfig } from 'kay/server'

export default defineConfig({
  lang: 'en',
  ...(process.env.ORIGIN ? { site: process.env.ORIGIN } : {}),

})
EOF
cat > src/server.ts <<'EOF'
import process from 'node:process'
import { Elysia } from 'elysia'
import { pages } from 'kay/server'

// Exported for `kay check`, which checks links against the routes it serves besides the pages and types `ctx.locals` from its plugins.
export const app = new Elysia().use(await pages()).listen({
  port: Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3000),
  ...(process.env.HOST ? { hostname: process.env.HOST } : {}),
})

console.log(`Listening on http://${app.server?.hostname}:${app.server?.port}`)
EOF

echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid; sleep 2; cat /tmp/srv.log
B=http://localhost:4701; A=/_kay/action/src/routes/contact.kay/contact
H=(-H "Origin: http://localhost:4701" -H "Referer: http://localhost:4701/contact")
echo "== invalid"; curl -s -w "\nSTATUS %{http_code}\n" "${H[@]}" -F name=" " -F email="bad@x" -F message="short" $B$A | grep -o '<main>.*</main>\|STATUS.*'
echo "== empty email"; curl -s "${H[@]}" -F name="Ann" -F email="" -F message="short message here, but long enough" $B$A | grep -o '<form.*</form>'
echo "== valid"; curl -s -c /tmp/cj -D - -o /dev/null "${H[@]}" -F name="  Ann  " -F email="ann@example.com" -F message="This is a long enough message." $B$A | grep -i "^HTTP\|^location"
curl -s -b /tmp/cj $B/contact | grep -o '<main>.*</main>'
echo "== 127 host"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Origin: http://localhost:4701" -F name=a -F email=a -F message=a http://127.0.0.1:4701$A
rm e2e-tmp.ts; kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid); sleep 0.5; pgrep -af "server.ts" | grep -v pgrep; bun run check && bun run build | tail -1; git status --short

outside: Bash: grep -n -i "browser\|chrom\|playwright" docs/llms/testing.md | head -20; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome firefox 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null

Bash: ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1234/*/; cat > e2e-tmp.ts <<'EOF'
import { browse } from 'kay/test'

const B = 'http://localhost:4701'
const ok = (c: unknown, m: string) => console.log(c ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', m)

const p = await browse(`${B}/books`)
ok(await p.count('ul[aria-label="Books"] li') === 8, '8 books')
await p.click('button:nth-of-type(3)') // gothic
await p.waitUntil(() => document.querySelectorAll('ul[aria-label="Books"] li').length === 3)
ok(await p.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.filter button')].map(b => b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')).join()) === 'false,false,true,false,false,false,false,false,false', 'pressed state')
ok(await p.path() === '/books', 'no navigation')
await p.click('.filter button:first-child')
await p.waitUntil(() => document.querySelectorAll('ul[aria-label="Books"] li').length === 8)
ok(true, 'All restores')

await p.goto(`${B}/books/dracula`)
await p.waitFor('article button', { text: 'Add to favorites' })
await p.click('article button')
await p.waitFor('article button', { text: 'Remove from favorites' })
await p.reload()
await p.waitFor('article button', { text: 'Remove from favorites' })
ok(true, 'favorite survives reload')
await p.goto(`${B}/books`)
await p.waitUntil(() => document.querySelectorAll('.favorite').length === 1)
ok((await p.text('ul[aria-label="Books"] li:nth-child(2)'))?.includes('Favorite'), 'Dracula marked Favorite')
ok(!(await p.text('ul[aria-label="Books"] li:nth-child(3)'))?.includes('Favorite'), 'Frankenstein not marked')
ok(await p.text('nav a[aria-current="page"]') === 'Books', 'nav current')

await p.goto(`${B}/contact`)
await p.fill('#email', 'bad')
await p.click('button[type="submit"]')
await p.waitFor('.error', { text: 'Name is required.' })
ok(await p.count('.error') === 3, '3 errors client side: ' + await p.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.error')].map(e => e.textContent).join('|')))
ok(await p.path() === '/contact', 'still on contact')
await p.fill('#name', '  Zoe ')
await p.fill('#email', 'zoe@example.com')
await p.fill('#message', 'Hello there, this is long enough.')
await p.click('button[type="submit"]')
await p.waitFor('.success', { text: 'Thanks, Zoe! Your message has been sent.' })
ok(await p.count('.error') === 0, 'errors cleared')
console.log('errors:', p.errors)
process.exit(0)
EOF
BUN_CHROME_PATH=$(ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1234/chrome-linux*/chrome) timeout 90 bun e2e-tmp.ts
